name: Rod of Rulership

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Command Obedience
powers.text: Magic action (once per dawn): creatures of your choice within 120 ft make a DC 15 Wisdom save or are Charmed by you for 8 hours.

summary: Once a day, creatures of your choice within 120 ft are Charmed by you for 8 hours unless they make a DC 15 Wisdom save.
text: You can take a Magic action to present the rod and command obedience from each creature of your choice that you can see within 120 feet of you. Each target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for 8 hours. While Charmed in this way, the creature regards you as its trusted leader. If harmed by you or your companions, or commanded to do something contrary to its nature, a target ceases to be Charmed in this way. The rod can't be used again until the next dawn.
